title: stemflux: Window Selection, Empirical Precision and Detection Limits for Chamber Flux Data Processed with goFlux
description: An R package extending goFlux (Rheault et al. 2024) with tools for tree-stem, soil and water chamber flux measurements: stacked CO2/CH4 window selection, non-interactive window detection, empirical per-measurement precision (Allan deviation of first differences, robust MAD variant), minimum detectable flux by several published methods with detection flags, a chamber-contamination screen, a ggplot2-compatible PDF exporter, analyzer clock-reset handling, ebullition detection and partitioning, and import helpers for very large LI-7810 files.
